title: Projects
text:
Conducted in-depth analysis of U.S. tariff impacts on Canada, focusing on sectoral exposure across automotive, energy, and manufacturing industries.
Evaluated fiscal risks using historical debt data (2015–2024) and projected interest cost trends.
Developed strategic recommendations for Chinese financial institutions, including trade finance expansion and cross-border RMB services.





Built statistical models to estimate GDP contraction, employment changes, and inflation risks under a 25% tariff scenario.
Analyzed trade flows and supply chain disruptions using historical data (2019–2023).
Delivered policy insights to support risk mitigation and diversification strategies.





Led a team to redesign program structures and improve participation rates through data-driven insights.
Developed strategic business plans and budget frameworks for community outreach initiatives.





Designed a $2.39 million budget plan to improve food supply chains in rural China.
Proposed financial incentives and partnership strategies involving governments and financial institutions.

title: About
text:
Zifan Chen

Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics candidate at Boston University, with a strong background in corporate banking, financial analysis, and international economic research.
Currently working as a Corporate Banking Associate at Bank of China (Toronto Branch), I support relationship management, credit analysis, and syndicated loan operations across industries including energy, real estate, transportation, and manufacturing.
My academic and professional experience focuses on: - Corporate finance and credit risk analysis
- Cross-border trade and financial services
- Macroeconomic policy and financial risk assessment
I have been actively involved in research projects analyzing the impact of U.S. tariff policies on Canada and developing strategic responses for financial institutions. These experiences have strengthened my ability to connect macroeconomic trends with practical financial decision-making.
My career goal is to pursue roles in corporate banking, investment banking, or financial strategy, where I can leverage both analytical skills and client-facing experience to deliver value in complex financial environments.
